name: System Designer — native Rust
purpose:
Native desktop System Designer. No webview, HTML, JavaScript, CSS, backend, or AI connection. Preserve recursive typed design, explicit contract dialogs, scoped AI exchange, and local project files. Start blank; expose this self-design as an optional built-in example. The initialization prompt and this JSON are compiled into the executable.

This model includes the unified View / Focus / Arrange canvas integration. Verification and limitations are recorded in docs/CANVAS-INTEGRATION.md. The self-design is not a claim of full native runtime or platform qualification.

Design convention: roughly eight or fewer immediate components per level, justified by independent responsibilities, not a hard validator limit. This tree has seven top-level components and at most eight beneath each. Parent systems own all local edges; public ports are projected into child boundaries.

IMPORTANT: Edges below describe responsibility-level interfaces and return paths, NOT a deployed message bus. Some schemas use JSON projections of typed in-process values because the editor's shape language cannot express Rust references or recursive type definitions. These are explanatory contracts, not generated runtime ABI declarations. Source paths in node purposes map the design to the implementation. The application itself keeps direct Rust calls and one Store.

contracts.name: ViewContext
contracts.purpose: Responsibility-level projection of a borrowed Project, current system, selection, and Store generation. UI functions pass typed references, not a serialized event envelope.

contracts.name: EditRequest
contracts.purpose: A human gesture or form submission requesting a bounded mutation. Arguments are represented as JSON here for discussion; implementation uses typed Rust function arguments and candidate closures, not an event bus.

contracts.name: ProjectSnapshot
contracts.purpose: The current validated Project and generation. The diagram uses project_json as an explicit serialized projection; the running editor holds the typed Project in Store. No duplicate authoritative copy.

contracts.name: ProjectCandidate
contracts.purpose: An uncommitted complete Project produced by an edit or scoped replacement; it must pass full-project validation before publication. Serialized projection of the in-process Rust value.

contracts.name: ValidationRequest
contracts.purpose: Request to parse or validate a complete model. Source uses parse(&str) and validate(&Project); this diagram records an inspectable serialization of the same candidate, not a prescribed wire protocol.

contracts.name: ValidationResult
contracts.purpose: Projection of Result<(), ModelError>: success or precise structural problems. Passing this check says nothing about architecture quality or acceptance.

contracts.name: FileRequest
contracts.purpose: User-authorized local project or recovery operation, corresponding to workspace load/save and storage calls. No network or project-supplied code is executed. project_json carries the candidate for writes; it is empty for reads. An empty expected_fingerprint means the file is expected not to exist.

contracts.name: ScopeRequest
contracts.purpose: Parameters to export/replace functions. The packet_json field holds the exact version-1 scope packet when replacing; empty for export. Scope identity and context are checked by the implementation.

contracts.name: PointerSample
contracts.purpose: Screen-space pointer sample and resolved local hit consumed by the existing gesture state. Empty target IDs mean not applicable; role describes effective local direction, including projected owner ports. This is not a second input framework.

contracts.name: CanvasGeometry
contracts.purpose: Frame-local drawing projection derived from the selected system, optional layout, and viewport transform. geometry_json includes coordinates, labels, port bindings and derived boundary links needed to draw the frame. It cannot change semantic project truth.

contracts.name: FileResult
contracts.purpose: Projection of local read/write Result values. document_json is populated for successful reads; fingerprint is populated for successful project-file reads and saves. Recovery and failures may omit a fingerprint by using an empty string. Failed durability sync may follow a visible replacement, so failure is not a claim that no disk effect occurred.

contracts.name: ContractDraft
contracts.purpose: An editable contract definition, not a complete project. definition_json is the exact nested Shape JSON. Native forms edit a typed Contract and Shape directly.

contracts.name: ScopePacket
contracts.purpose: Exact serialized version-1 System Designer scope envelope. It is copied to another service manually, not transmitted by the application.

contracts.name: InitializationText
contracts.purpose: Complete design and JSON exchange instructions embedded using include_str!. Contains no user project information.

contracts.name: Canvas emphasis
contracts.purpose: Presentation-only projection of exact membership and selection. Not a new design graph, persisted scope packet, executable control-flow rule or live runtime state.

nodes.name: Workspace
nodes.purpose: Compose the native app and one document lifecycle. Map @root/component behavior owners to optional interface systems; remember each layer camera and selection. Leaf behavior needs no structural child. Source: src/ui/mod.rs, scope.rs, workspace.rs.

nodes.name: Canvas
nodes.purpose: Render and select interface geometry and explicit control-flow shapes. Reuse the sampled Path for picking, arrows and direction lights; control lights do not simulate execution. Source: src/ui/canvas/ and src/ui/flow/drawing.rs. Flow arrangement remains manual.

nodes.name: Authoring forms
nodes.purpose: Draft component, flow-step, transition, information and contract edits; guide region membership, purpose and boundary review before a single extraction. Source: src/ui/inspector.rs, contracts.rs, flow/forms.rs and flow/inspect.rs.

nodes.name: Edits and history
nodes.purpose: Build and publish complete candidates through Store. Extract supported local regions and reconcile exact port/edge/DataLink contract bindings atomically. Preserve stale-plan rejection and one-step undo. Source: src/edit/ and src/behavior/edit.rs, extract.rs.

nodes.name: Design model
nodes.purpose: Validate one authoritative v1/v2 Project, structural IDs/types and behavior ownership. Derive draft diagnostics and bounded graph complexity; no predicate interpreter or proof of dependency completeness. Source: src/model/ and src/behavior/model.rs, validate.rs.

nodes.name: AI handoff
nodes.purpose: Export and validate explicit Interfaces or current-owner Control Flow packets; preserve hidden content and recheck before applying. Embedded prompt documents the exact protocols. Context v1 remains conservative: full catalog in behavior packets, some sibling interiors in interface packets. Source: src/ui/handoff.rs, src/exchange/, src/behavior/exchange.rs.

nodes.name: Local files
nodes.purpose: Save/reopen both layers and saved layouts; protect unsaved documents, retain backups and recover published edits. Native OS dialog/platform qualification remains separate from model tests. Source: src/storage.rs.

nodes.name: Native host
nodes.purpose:
Create the eframe window and renderer; accept an optional project path. No web runtime.

Source: src/main.rs

Branding: src/main.rs and src/ui/branding.rs embed the approved icon and match the Linux desktop ID. build.rs links the Windows executable icon; packaging supplies native launcher/bundle resources. No project-data effect.

nodes.name: Document lifecycle
nodes.purpose:
Own Store integration, current path, saved fingerprint, dirty comparison, load/save guards, and recovery scheduling.

Source: src/ui/mod.rs::Designer

nodes.name: Tree and breadcrumbs
nodes.purpose: Map semantic owners and optional interface systems; retain separate scope/layer cameras, selections and Back targets, pruning invalid state after edits and loads. src/ui/scope.rs.

nodes.name: Application controls
nodes.purpose:
Expose file/edit commands, keyboard shortcuts, undo/redo and local complexity guidance.

Source: src/ui/workspace.rs

Branding: src/ui/branding.rs displays the embedded atom icon in the toolbar and Help; cached UI resources do not alter the design model or scoped exchange.

nodes.name: Dialog shell
nodes.purpose:
Block underlying editing while a modal draft is open. Support Save/Discard/Cancel and preserve failed candidate errors.

Source: src/ui/inspector.rs::show_dialog

nodes.name: Geometry projection
nodes.purpose: Derive four-sided interface geometry and shape-perimeter control attachments; share exact sampled cubic Path geometry. src/ui/canvas/geometry.rs and src/ui/flow/drawing.rs.

nodes.name: Viewport and navigation
nodes.purpose: Keep pan, zoom, fit and remembered level viewports separate from project positions. View switches preserve origins and camera. Source: src/ui/canvas.rs; src/ui/canvas/focus.rs::Viewport.

nodes.name: Drawing and direction lights
nodes.purpose: Paint the final exact or summarized route. Drawing, picking, arrowheads and lights share the same path; motion follows displayed arc length and is illustrative only. Focus suppresses muted lights. Source: src/ui/canvas.rs; src/ui/canvas/motion.rs.

nodes.name: Exact hit testing
nodes.purpose: Pick actual ports, cards or presented relationships from their final display geometry. A multi-edge summary identifies an ordered pair, never an arbitrary editable member. Source: src/ui/canvas.rs; geometry::Path::distance.

nodes.name: Gesture and control dispatch
nodes.purpose: Handle interface wires and flow transitions in either drag direction, local step movement, region selection and cancellation. Publish only completed validated edits; forms provide a keyboard alternative.

nodes.name: Overview projection
nodes.purpose: Derive compact cards and counted, directed component-pair summaries. Keep exact member IDs; boundary and self-loop edges remain individual. Selected exact edges are never promoted to their groups. Source: src/ui/canvas/overview.rs.

nodes.name: Focus and exact tracing
nodes.purpose: Compute one-hop membership over real edges before aggregation. Inspect exact members and navigate through the identical boundary port. Restore complete session trace locations; never infer input-to-output causality. Source: src/ui/canvas/focus.rs.

nodes.name: Connection-aware arrangement
nodes.purpose: On explicit command, arrange the complete current-level graph with temporary feedback groups and bounded Detail-size measurement. Preserve all edges, scope hashes and other levels; publish positions once through the existing edit boundary. Source: src/ui/canvas/arrangement.rs.

nodes.name: Context inspector
nodes.purpose: Expose exact identity, local ownership, shared call references, draft issues, information needs and deliberate navigation between layers.

nodes.name: Component form
nodes.purpose: Edit canonical component identity, local steps, transitions, stopping explanations and human-reviewed extraction drafts. Cancel publishes nothing.

nodes.name: Connection dialog
nodes.purpose: Review exact public ports, interface wires and behavior DataLinks before atomic contract refinement, including a new structured definition.

nodes.name: Contract catalog
nodes.purpose:
Create, inspect, edit, version or delete catalog definitions; protect referenced identities.

Source: src/ui/inspector.rs::show_dialog; src/ui/contracts.rs::contract_form

nodes.name: Schema form
nodes.purpose:
Edit primitives, enums, arrays and nested object fields in native controls. No untyped runtime schema engine.

Source: src/ui/contracts.rs::shape_form

nodes.name: Typed records
nodes.purpose: Persist supported behavior steps, descriptive alternatives, exact data bindings, primitive criteria and both independent layouts in native project version 2.

nodes.name: Structural validation
nodes.purpose: Separate saveable draft gaps from hard identity/type errors. Diagnose missing child outcomes, duplicate unguarded returns and unreviewed local information use.

nodes.name: Derived views
nodes.purpose: Derive scope ownership, public boundaries, call uses, draft issues and bounded normalized graph metrics; no runtime or inferred causal dependencies.

nodes.name: Bounded edits
nodes.purpose: Build validated structural and flow edits and bounded local-region extraction; preserve crossing IDs and explicit alternatives; explain unsupported crossings.

nodes.name: Connection consistency
nodes.purpose: Follow exact shared port, interface-edge and DataLink constraints to preview and reconcile contract assignments in one candidate. Names or equal old types do not imply coupling.

nodes.name: Publication and history
nodes.purpose:
Own the authoritative current Project. Reject invalid candidates without mutating current/undo/redo; publish one undoable action and retain up to 50 snapshots.

Source: src/edit/history.rs

nodes.name: Handoff panel
nodes.purpose:
Offer embedded initialization text, scope choice, copy/save JSON, and separate Validate/Apply actions. Revalidate at Apply.

Source: src/ui/handoff.rs

nodes.name: Embedded guidance
nodes.purpose:
Carry design methodology and exact exchange instructions in the executable. No project data, credentials or remote service.

Source: src/lib.rs::INITIALIZATION; assets/initialization.txt

nodes.name: Scope projection
nodes.purpose: Preserve existing version-1 hashes and behavior context-policy version 1. Export exact local exchanges, child signatures, caller references and the full behavior contract catalog; minimal context remains a gap.

nodes.name: Scoped replacement
nodes.purpose: Dispatch exact packet formats, reject missing flow, preview explicit null clearing, recheck scope/base/context, then validate the merged project before Store publication.

nodes.name: Validated reading
nodes.purpose:
Read UTF-8 project JSON and fingerprint exact source bytes; report malformed or unsupported records instead of treating them as valid.

Source: src/storage.rs::read_project; stamp

nodes.name: Safe replacement
nodes.purpose:
Check expected file fingerprint, preserve the previous valid saved file, sync a same-directory temporary file, and replace the target. Not a distributed compare-and-swap.

Source: src/storage.rs::save_project; atomic_write

nodes.name: Recovery snapshots
nodes.purpose:
Write isolated per-session recovery files in user data storage. Restore as an unsaved copy; preserve damaged and foreign-session bytes.

Source: src/storage.rs::write_recovery; read_recovery; recovery_files
